Chinese Chipmaker CXMT Shares Surge 470% on Shanghai Debut

Chinese semiconductor manufacturer CXMT saw its shares surge by nearly 470% on its debut on the Shanghai Stock Exchange. The company's stock experienced a significant jump, marking Asia's largest IPO. This surge is attributed to the ongoing boom in artificial intelligence (AI) and the resulting high demand for chips.
